method: Manual native-coordinate polygons traced visually from the supplied photo only, rasterized with Pillow without resizing or antialiasing. White means visible palace roofs and facades; black means all other pixels.
blindness: No target masks, source renders, camera files, prompts, previous images, or metrics were inspected.
included: Visible palace wings and pavilions, including their shadowed facades.
excluded: Open western court floor and narrow visible floors of two north-wing recesses; large open court; streets; city blocks; trees; statue; people; all other surroundings.

uncertainEdges.detail: Small north-wing recess: dark windowed vertical faces retained; narrow floor boundary partly occluded by foreground roof. Manual floor estimate may vary by about 3-5 pixels.
Second north-wing recess: narrow visible floor separated from dark facade by a manual estimate; about 3-5 pixel ambiguity.
Back roofline has fine chimneys and partial tree occlusions. Polygon follows visible architectural outline, with about 2-4 pixel uncertainty on small details.
Fine tower pinnacles and roof ornaments traced approximately to their visible silhouettes; several 1-3 pixel ornaments may be omitted.
Western oblique edge and facade foot: local vegetation overlap and small roof ornaments give about 2-4 pixel boundary uncertainty.
Long foreground roofline and facade base include manual small-scale tracing; subpixel and fine rail/chimney details are approximate.
